name: Mei Li
bio:
Mei Li's journey into the high-stakes world of motorsport security began unexpectedly. After a decade in corporate security, she found herself drawn to the unique challenges presented by the fast-paced, high-profile environment of racing. Her meticulous approach and keen eye for detail quickly made her an invaluable asset. Mei excels at risk assessment and preventative security measures, ensuring the safety of personnel, equipment, and intellectual property.

Driven by a commitment to excellence, Mei believes in fostering a collaborative security team that anticipates threats before they materialize. She emphasizes continuous training and staying ahead of the curve with the latest security technologies. Her ability to adapt to constantly evolving security landscapes, combined with her unwavering focus, sets her apart in the field. Her work ethic and team spirit are infectious, bringing a sense of calm to a stressful environment.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, straight hair with subtle layers and a neatly trimmed fringe
physical.description: A slim woman with a serious but friendly demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-organized notebook and pen, even in casual settings.
Insists on double-checking all security protocols, regardless of how recently they were reviewed.
Prefers herbal tea over coffee, claiming it helps her stay focused.
